language_check.method: Script screen only; Latin-script languages are not automatically distinguished from English.

windows.quote:
I meant to make a short walking guide for a friend's visit on Sunday. I still want to send something useful by then, but first I need to check whether there is an accessible alternative to the quieter road by the river. I have not checked that yet. I liked the road, though its uneven pavement would make me hesitate to recommend it to someone using a wheelchair; I should not present my preferred route as suitable for everyone.

On Wednesday, the walk from the station to the old footbridge took me thirty-five minutes instead of the twenty I had estimated, partly because I stopped to check two street names. I did not time a second walk. Those thirty-five minutes are a record of that trip, not a reliable estimate for everyone.

The map had helped me as far as the market, where it showed a path behind the stalls. When I got there, a locked gate blocked the entrance. I cannot tell whether it is normally locked or whether I arrived at the wrong time. I should describe what I found in the guide and leave the usual access hours unconfirmed; a clear note about what I have and have not checked would help more than pretending that one walk settled every question.

known_limitations: In the saved 36-document English pilot, high-score false positives occurred on human writing. Do not treat a near-1 score as established authorship.
notes: Four-class model outputs are not proof of authorship or percentages of words.
AI involvement = ai + ai_edited + humanized; human is the mutually exclusive class.
Multi-window document aggregation has not been calibrated; document probability is unavailable.
The model card's threshold at 0.5% FPR is a vendor benchmark setting, not a local guarantee.
Short passages, translations and unfamiliar domains can be unreliable.

occlusion.interpretation: Sensitivity to deleting a paragraph. Positive delta means removal lowered the score; length/context changes confound this. This is not causal authorship evidence or a sentence probability.
